FLORIDA 300X THE CASH's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

The numbers for "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5048.headline: Top prizes are still left

5055.body:
The most common win left on "EMERALD MINE 9X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and eight of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If "EMERALD MINE 9X" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
